component.name: Tyag
component.summary: Local-first addiction and habit recovery tracker

description.p: Tyag is a private, offline recovery tracker. Log urges, habits and sessions, watch your streaks grow and understand your patterns, without ever creating an account or sending data anywhere.

ul.li: Everything is stored locally in a single SQLite database on this device.
No account, no sign-in, no analytics and no network access at all.
Streak engine, journal, analytics and insights are all computed on-device.
Backup, restore and JSON export use plain local files.

description.p: Because the app is fully offline, it works on a plane, in a clinic and in airplane mode, and there is no server that could ever see your data.
Persistent PIN brute-force protection with escalating lockouts, and refreshed Tyag brand assets and social card.
Cross-platform Back navigation, an opaque mobile tab bar, and Android status/navigation bars that blend with the app canvas.
First release: offline tracking, streaks, journal, insights and local backup/export.
